entry.description: Number of the row in `entries` (1 = first) the reaction is printed in

part.description: null when the whole cell belongs to this reaction; else the part of the cell text that does, copied exactly

results.description: The result cells of this reaction

variant.description: Key of the template variant whose label is printed for this reaction; null without a label

footnote_markers.description: Markers printed in the row (on the entry number or in a cell) that apply to this reaction; never those of the title or of a column header

distinguishing.description: Only when the row reports more than one reaction: what sets this one apart, as printed ('COMU', '60 °C'); else null

column.description: Key of a participant or variable column

part.description: The part of that cell's text that is this reaction's own, copied exactly

cells.description: Only when the row reports several reactions that differ in a compound or a variable value printed together in one cell ('4c / 4d', 'R = Et, iPr'): this reaction's part of that cell. Empty otherwise

reactions.description: Every reaction of the table in row order: one per row, unless a row reports several experiments

notes.description: Why a row was split, or what is unusual about it; nothing for plain rows

issues.description: Doubts a reviewer should look at
